description: Snow and Ice Clearing Priority Routes is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. Snow clearing for Priority 1 (major roads such as Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Memorial Drive, 16 Avenue) and Priority 2 routes (collector roads, major community access roads, bus routes etc.) Priority 1 Routes: Roads carrying more than 20,000 vehicles per day. Snow Clearing Commitment: Priority 1 routes are cleared within 18 hours of snow ending. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Health and Safety. Its tags are snow, priority, ice, clearing. The table has 2 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
